name: Jack Herer
description: Named after the legendary cannabis activist, Jack Herer is the gold standard sativa. Earthy and pine-forward with a spicy finish. Delivers blissful, clear-headed creativity and lasting energy — a true daytime classic.

name: Durban Poison
description: A pure landrace sativa from South Africa. Sweet, earthy, and distinctly spicy with hints of anise. One of the cleanest, most energizing highs available — no ceiling, no anxiety. Built for productivity.

name: Blue Dream
description: California's most beloved hybrid. Sweet blueberry aroma with a full-body relaxation that doesn't sedate. A perfectly balanced experience — calm, creative, and sociable. The perfect introduction to cannabis and a perennial favorite.

name: Girl Scout Cookies
description: GSC is a landmark strain that changed the industry. Sweet, earthy, and slightly minty with a powerful euphoric punch. Potent, long-lasting, and unmistakably complex — one of the most awarded strains ever cultivated.

name: Gelato
description: Gelato is dessert in strain form. Creamy, sweet, and slightly citrusy — it smells exactly like it sounds. Delivers a balanced euphoria that's heavy on the good vibes without knocking you out. Extremely popular for good reason.

name: Skywalker
description: Skywalker is a heavy-hitting indica with a sweet, slightly spicy aroma and fruity undertones. Deep body relaxation, calming euphoria, and a natural transition into sleep. The force is strong with this one.

name: Skywalker OG
description: Skywalker meets OG Kush in one of the most potent indica-dominant hybrids around. Diesel and earthy pine on the nose, massive body high, and a euphoria that eventually gives way to deep sedation. Not for beginners.

name: OG Kush
description: The strain that defined California cannabis. Fuel and citrus on the nose, deep earthy pine on the exhale. OG Kush delivers a heavy euphoria and full-body relaxation with unmistakable complexity. Everything descended from it owes its character here.

name: Granddaddy Purple
description: GDP is one of the most iconic indicas in existence. Deep purple buds, grape candy aroma, and a heavy full-body sedation that makes it the gold standard for sleep and pain relief. Sweet, beautiful, and deeply relaxing.

name: Northern Lights
description: One of the most legendary indicas ever bred. Northern Lights is resinous, earthy, and sweet with a deeply sedating body high. A benchmark for pure indica effects — the kind of relaxation that starts in your head and melts through your whole body.

name: Bubba Kush
description: Bubba Kush is the definition of a heavy indica. Sweet earthy notes with hints of coffee and chocolate. The kind of stone that pins you to the couch in the best possible way — ideal for evenings, stress relief, and winding down after a long day.

name: Purple Kush
description: A pure indica from the Hindu Kush mountain range. Sweet grape and berry flavors with a deep earthy base. Long-lasting body sedation with a dreamy, peaceful euphoria. A staple for anyone who wants a true indica experience.

name: Hindu Kush
description: A pure landrace indica from the mountain range between Afghanistan and Pakistan. Earthy, woody, and classic. Hindu Kush produces a heavy, peaceful sedation that's been cherished for centuries. The grandfather of modern indicas.

name: Sour Diesel
description: Sour Diesel is one of the most recognizable strains in the world. Pungent diesel fuel aroma with a sharp citrus edge. Fast-acting, cerebral, and energizing — the choice for creative work, daytime use, and anyone who needs to be on their A game.

name: Super Lemon Haze
description: Super Lemon Haze hits you with bright lemon zest the moment you open the jar. A multi-award winning sativa that delivers sharp, uplifting energy and creative clarity. Citrusy, sweet, and powerfully motivating — sunshine in a strain.

name: Green Crack
description: Don't let the name scare you — Green Crack is one of the most purely energizing sativas around. Tangy citrus and mango flavor with a sharp mental buzz that keeps you locked in. Perfect for a productive day when you need serious focus.

name: Tangie
description: Tangie smells and tastes exactly like a fresh-peeled tangerine — it's remarkable. Uplifting, happy, and creatively inspired. One of the most flavorful sativas available, with an aroma so true to fruit it almost seems impossible.

name: Wedding Cake
description: Wedding Cake (also known as Pink Cookies) is rich, tangy, and loaded with sweet vanilla and earthy undertones. High-THC, deeply euphoric, and powerfully relaxing. A celebration-worthy strain with serious potency and exceptional flavor.

name: Runtz
description: Runtz is the candy strain. Sweet, fruity, and creamy like actual candy — the aroma is addictive before you even light up. Delivers a long-lasting euphoria and full-body relaxation. One of the most hyped strains of the last decade, and it lives up to it.

name: Gorilla Glue #4
description: GG4 is one of the most potent hybrids ever cultivated. Extremely resinous, pungent and earthy — it earned its name. The high is heavy, euphoric, and full-body. A couch-locker that starts with mental euphoria and gradually pins you in place.

name: Pineapple Express
description: Yes, it's real and yes it's excellent. Pineapple Express smells like fresh tropical fruit and delivers a long-lasting, energetic buzz with waves of euphoria. Creative, social, and genuinely fun — a perfect daytime hybrid.

name: White Widow
description: White Widow is a legend. One of the most famous hybrids ever created, bred in the Netherlands in the 1990s. Earthy and slightly sweet with a burst of pure euphoria and creative energy that doesn't quit. A true classic.

name: AK-47
description: Don't be misled by the name — AK-47 is a mellow, multi-award winning hybrid. Earthy, sweet, and complex. Delivers steady, creative relaxation without sedation. A go-to for social situations, creative work, and anyone who wants clear-headed calm.

name: Chemdawg
description: The strain that launched a thousand others. Chemdawg is the parent of OG Kush and Sour Diesel, and you can taste both in its lineage. Pungent diesel and chemical aroma with a cerebral, creative euphoria and strong body relaxation.

name: Zkittlez
description: Zkittlez tastes exactly like the candy — sweet, fruity, and bursting with tropical and berry notes. It delivers a calming, happy body high without heavy sedation. Perfect for unwinding while staying present and social.

name: Do-Si-Dos
description: Do-Si-Dos is a potent indica-dominant hybrid with a complex sweet and earthy flavor profile accented by floral, lime notes. Deeply relaxing with a strong euphoric onset that transitions into heavy body sedation. High-THC and not for the faint-hearted.

name: Purple Punch
description: Purple Punch smells like grape candy and blueberry muffins. Delivers a one-two punch of relaxation — first a euphoric head high, then a sedating body stone. Beautiful purple buds, incredible flavor, and a nighttime experience unlike anything else.

name: Ice Cream Cake
description: Ice Cream Cake is dessert-tier cannabis. Creamy vanilla and sweet earthy notes with a hint of nuttiness. Deeply relaxing, mildly sedating, and loaded with euphoria. The kind of strain you save for the end of a long day.

name: Master Kush
description: Master Kush is a timeless classic from Amsterdam with deep Hindu Kush heritage. Earthy, citrusy, and slightly sweet with a powerful body high and mental relaxation. Award-winning, consistent, and deeply satisfying.

name: Blueberry
description: DJ Short's Blueberry is one of the most celebrated indicas ever created. The aroma is unmistakable — rich, sweet blueberry with floral undertones. A long-lasting body high and deeply calming euphoria. A true gem.

name: Strawberry Cough
description: Strawberry Cough is exactly what it sounds like — fresh strawberry sweetness that expands in the lungs. One of the most approachable sativas, delivering uplifting happiness, creative energy, and a social buzz without anxiety.

name: Trainwreck
description: Trainwreck hits fast and hard. This sativa-dominant hybrid delivers a rush of creative, euphoric energy that transitions into a smooth body relaxation. Pine, lemon, and spice on the palate. Good for experienced users who want a powerful ride.

name: Super Silver Haze
description: Three-time Cannabis Cup winner, Super Silver Haze is an old-school classic with serious credentials. Earthy and citrusy with a long-lasting cerebral high. Energizing, creative, and euphoric — the kind of sativa that launched careers in this industry.

name: Maui Wowie
description: Maui Wowie is Hawaiian sun in a strain. Sweet pineapple and tropical fruit flavors, light and airy with a euphoric, carefree energy. Great for outdoor activities, creative work, and anyone who wants a smooth, approachable daytime sativa.

name: Amnesia Haze
description: Amnesia Haze is a staple of Amsterdam coffeeshops for good reason. Powerful, long-lasting euphoria with a sharp, citrusy and earthy flavor. One of the most potent sativas available — not for the faint-hearted. The kind of high that demands your full attention.

name: Bruce Banner
description: Named after the Hulk's alter ego, Bruce Banner is one of the highest-THC strains available. Sweet diesel and strawberry aroma — Chemdawg lineage you can smell. A powerful euphoric onset that mellows into relaxed creativity. Incredibly potent.

name: Mimosa
description: Mimosa is the brunch of cannabis strains — bright citrus aroma, uplifting and social. Perfect morning or early afternoon choice that delivers clean energy and happiness without sedation. Sativa-dominant with a beautiful orange and tropical flavor profile.

name: Sunset Sherbet
description: Sunset Sherbet is a GSC descendant with an incredibly complex flavor — sweet berry, citrus, and creamy notes. Delivers full-body relaxation and mental euphoria without full sedation. Beautiful bag appeal and a truly satisfying experience.

name: Forbidden Fruit
description: Forbidden Fruit lives up to its name — the aroma is luscious tropical fruit and wild cherry. Deeply relaxing indica-dominant hybrid with a potent body high and calming euphoria. One of the most flavorful and visually stunning strains around.

name: Cherry Pie
description: Cherry Pie smells like fresh-baked cherry pastry — sweet, fruity, and slightly floral. A balanced hybrid that delivers euphoric happiness and gentle relaxation without heavy sedation. Consistent, reliable, and genuinely delicious.

name: Animal Cookies
description: Animal Cookies is a GSC descendant with pungent, sweet, and sour notes. High-THC with a heavy, full-body stone and lasting euphoria. Best reserved for evenings — this one takes hold and doesn't let go.

name: Clementine
description: Clementine is a citrus lover's dream. The aroma is sharp, sweet clementine orange — bright and instantly mood-lifting. Delivers a clean, focused sativa energy with creative uplifting effects. One of the most aromatic strains in the game.

name: Lemon Skunk
description: Lemon Skunk delivers exactly what it advertises — sharp lemon citrus with an earthy skunk backbone. Uplifting, cheerful, and sociable. A classic Amsterdam strain with award history and a flavor profile that's instantly recognizable.

name: LA Confidential
description: LA Confidential is a pure indica powerhouse with earthy, pine, and woody notes. Fast-acting and deeply sedating, with a smooth euphoria that fades into heavy sleep. A favorite for insomnia, chronic pain, and serious relaxation.

name: Banana Kush
description: Banana Kush smells exactly like ripe bananas — warm, sweet, and tropical. Delivers a laid-back, happy stone with gradual body relaxation and a case of the munchies. A perfect evening wind-down with one of the most unique and pleasant aromas around.

name: Fire OG
description: One of the strongest OG Kush phenotypes available. Fire OG is potent, pungent, and long-lasting. Lemon and earthy pine aroma with a heavy euphoria and deep body sedation. Demands experience — but rewards it deeply.

name: Cereal Milk
description: Cereal Milk smells like the leftover milk in a bowl of fruity cereal — sweet, creamy, and nostalgic. A balanced hybrid with euphoric happiness and gentle relaxation. Bag appeal is exceptional, flavor is unique, effects are smooth and pleasant.

name: MAC (Miracle Alien Cookies)
description: MAC is a collector's strain — perfectly balanced, visually stunning, and genuinely complex. Floral and diesel with citrus and herbal notes. Delivers a well-rounded euphoria and creative flow without heavy sedation. Highly sought after, and for good reason.

name: Slurricane
description: Slurricane is an indica-dominant powerhouse with rich grape and berry sweetness and a tropical finish. Heavy, sedating, and euphoric — it hits like the storm it's named after. Best saved for evenings when nowhere to be.

name: Death Star
description: The force of an indica hits hard with Death Star. Pungent diesel and skunk aroma with a sweet earthy finish. A slow-building, heavy stone that fully relaxes mind and body. An evening strain for seasoned smokers.

name: Grape Ape
description: Grape Ape delivers on its name — deep grape candy and berry aroma with purple-tinged buds. A slow-onset indica with a heavy, relaxing body high and peaceful euphoria. Perfect for stress relief and sleep.

name: Alien OG
description: Alien OG is a high-potency OG Kush phenotype with sharp lemon and pine. The high is intensely psychoactive — cerebral, reflective, and eventually deeply sedating. A serious strain for experienced consumers who want to go to another planet.

name: Lemon Haze
description: Lemon Haze is a bright, citrusy sativa with an energizing, creative high. Zesty lemon aroma and a smooth, cheerful buzz. Great for daytime use, social settings, and anyone who needs a mood lift without sedation.

name: Tropicana Cookies
description: Tropicana Cookies is a visually stunning strain with orange citrus and tropical sweetness. Sativa-leaning with a bright, uplifting euphoria and creative energy. GSC meets Tangie in one of the most flavorful hybrids available.

name: Acapulco Gold
description: A legendary Mexican landrace sativa with decades of history. Earthy and caramel-sweet with a powerful, long-lasting cerebral high. Acapulco Gold is a piece of cannabis history — and it still delivers an exceptional experience.

name: Platinum GSC
description: Platinum GSC is an elevated phenotype of Girl Scout Cookies — denser, more resinous, and even more potent. Sweet, pungent, and complex with a powerful euphoria that transitions into deep body relaxation. For the connoisseur who wants the very best of the GSC line.

name: Ghost Train Haze
description: Ghost Train Haze is among the most potent sativas ever tested. Sharp citrus and floral aroma, with a cerebral rush that can feel intense for newcomers. Laser-focused creativity and energy. Not for beginners — for those who want the full sativa experience.

name: Chocolope
description: Chocolope is a rare and distinctive sativa with a truly unique flavor — rich chocolate and coffee with vanilla and earth. Smooth, energizing, and euphorically uplifting. A great morning or creative-session strain with an aroma unlike anything else.

name: Critical Mass
description: Critical Mass is notable for its unusually high CBD content alongside strong THC. Sweet and earthy with a calming, deeply relaxing effect. Excellent for pain, anxiety, and sleep without the heavy psychoactive punch of other indicas.

name: Larry OG
description: Larry OG is a cleaner, more refined OG phenotype — lemon, pine, and earthy notes with a balanced head-to-body high. Euphoric onset transitions into smooth relaxation without heavy sedation. A well-rounded OG experience for any time of day.

name: Afghani
description: Afghani is one of the original landrace indicas — the genetic foundation of countless modern strains. Pure earthy and pungent with sweet undertones. Heavy body stone, deeply sedating, and deeply historic. This is where it all began.

name: Purple Haze
description: The Jimi Hendrix classic. Purple Haze delivers a psychedelic cerebral high with vivid creativity and dreamy euphoria. One of the most iconic sativas in cannabis history — sweet berry aroma with an unmistakably trippy, uplifting effect.

name: NYC Diesel
description: The New York City cut of Diesel — grapefruit and lime over raw diesel fuel. Delivers a powerful, clear-headed cerebral high that's relentlessly energetic. Won multiple High Times Cannabis Cups and remains one of the most iconic East Coast strains.

name: Moby Dick
description: One of the most potent sativas ever documented — Moby Dick regularly tests at 27%+ THC. Descends from Haze and White Widow, delivering an intense cerebral rush that can be almost overwhelming in its euphoria. Not for beginners.

name: Neville's Haze
description: Named after cannabis breeder Neville Schoenmakers. A pure Haze-dominant sativa with an exceptionally long flowering time (90-120 days) and a soaring, almost trippy cerebral effect. One of the most respected sativas in connoisseur circles.

name: Power Plant
description: A South African sativa with overwhelming cerebral energy. Power Plant is known for explosive growth and an intense, almost stimulant-like high. Popular in Europe and ideal for daytime productivity tasks.

name: Colombian Gold
description: One of the original landrace sativas that shaped cannabis genetics in the 1970s. Colombian Gold is a smooth, clean high from a pure South American landrace — euphoric, motivating, and nowhere near as heavy as modern hybrids.

name: Panama Red
description: The legendary 1960s-70s landrace sativa from Central America. Panama Red delivers a long, dreamy high with smooth euphoria and creative energy. Extremely rare in its pure form today — a living piece of cannabis history.

name: Lamb's Bread
description: Bob Marley's legendary strain — a Jamaican landrace sativa revered for uplifting, introspective effects and a positive, motivated mindset. Lamb's Bread (or Lambsbread) is deeply tied to Rastafarian culture and reportedly one of Marley's personal favorites.

name: Casey Jones
description: Named after the Grateful Dead song. Casey Jones combines Trainwreck and East Coast Sour Diesel for a fast-hitting, intensely energetic sativa. Sweet and slightly diesel-forward with a rush of creative energy.

name: Kali Mist
description: A legendary sativa hybrid from the 1990s cannabis scene. Kali Mist won multiple Cannabis Cups for its smooth, clear-headed cerebral effect and spicy, herbal terpene profile. One of the most respected pure sativas in competition history.

name: Golden Goat
description: A happy accident — created when a Hawaiian-Romulan male accidentally pollinated a Mr. Dank plant in Kansas. The result is a supremely uplifting tropical sativa with sweet citrus and pine aromas. One of the most mood-elevating strains available.

name: Grapefruit
description: Exactly what it sounds like — an intensely citrus-forward sativa with bright grapefruit aroma. Grapefruit delivers classic sativa energy: euphoric, social, and motivating. A simple but extremely pleasant daytime strain.

name: Cinderella 99
description: Also known as C99 or Cindy. A fast-finishing sativa from Brothers Grimm with sweet tropical pineapple flavor and an intensely cerebral, psychedelic high. One of the most potent cerebral sativas available — famous for its fast 7-week flower cycle.

name: Tangerine Dream
description: A Barney's Farm classic — Tangerine Dream won the 2012 Cannabis Cup. Sweet tangerine and tropical citrus aromas with a balanced, long-lasting effect that's energetic and creative without being overwhelming.

name: Jillybean
description: One of the sweetest-smelling strains on the market. Jillybean has a fruity candy aroma of orange and mango that carries into its smoke. Delivers a bright, happy, social sativa high — perfect for daytime activities and social situations.

name: Apollo 13
description: A Brothers Grimm creation named after the famous Apollo 13 mission. Delivers a bright, clear-headed, intensely creative sativa high with fruity terpenes. Less potent than C99 but more approachable, with exceptional mood elevation.

name: Snowcap
description: A Northern California sativa with uniquely minty, menthol-laced terpenes alongside bright citrus. Snowcap delivers potent cerebral euphoria and creative energy with a refreshing cooling sensation in the smoke.

name: Laughing Buddha
description: A High Times Cannabis Cup winner from Barney's Farm. Laughing Buddha crosses Thai and Jamaican landraces for an intensely uplifting, smile-inducing sativa high. True to its name — this strain genuinely makes people laugh.

name: Red Congo
description: A rare African landrace sativa from the Congo region. Red Congo delivers a long-lasting, intensely cerebral high with great clarity and creativity. A true connoisseur strain — harder to find but worth seeking for its pure sativa effects.

name: Purple Urkle
description: The original purple strain from the Mendocino region of California. Purple Urkle has an unmistakable grape and tropical fruit aroma with heavy indica sedation. One of the parents of Granddaddy Purple and a classic in its own right.

name: God's Gift
description: The combination of OG Kush and Granddaddy Purple — arguably one of the best indica genetics possible. God's Gift delivers an immediate euphoric head rush followed by full-body sedation. Grape and citrus aromas. Strong enough to truly be a gift for insomnia and pain.

name: Kosher Kush
description: Three-time High Times Cannabis Cup winner and one of the most decorated indicas in history. Kosher Kush is a heavy-hitting OG Kush phenotype with exceptional potency and a deeply sedating, euphoric body effect. The gold standard for indica quality.

name: Pink Kush
description: Canada's most beloved indica — a staple of Canadian dispensaries. Pink Kush has a sweet vanilla and floral aroma unlike most Kush strains, with potent body-melting indica effects. Medical patients consistently rate it among the top strains for pain and insomnia.

name: Tahoe OG
description: One of the most respected OG phenotypes — specifically the Lake Tahoe cut. Tahoe OG hits faster and harder than most OG Kush variants, with intense lemon-pine aroma and deeply sedating effects. Considered one of the benchmarks for couch-lock indicas.

name: Pre-98 Bubba Kush
description: The original Bubba Kush cut from before 1998 — considered by many to be superior to all subsequent Bubba phenotypes. Pre-98 Bubba has a coffee and dark chocolate aroma with exceptional body sedation. A true California cannabis classic.

name: 9 Pound Hammer
genetics: Gooberry × Hell's OG × Jack the Ripper
description: A heavy-hitting indica from TGA Subcool Seeds. The name is apt — 9 Pound Hammer hits like a physical object. Grape and lime flavors with an exceptionally sedating body effect. One of the go-to strains for serious insomnia.

name: Blackberry Kush
description: Sweet blackberry jam over a deep earthy Kush base. Blackberry Kush delivers classic indica body sedation with a notably sweet, berry-forward flavor profile that's rare in the Kush category. Perfect evening strain for sweet-flavor lovers who want deep relaxation.

name: Romulan
description: Named after the Star Trek alien race for its mind-bending potency. Romulan is a heavily indica-dominant strain from British Columbia with intense pine resin aroma and powerful body sedation. Exceptional for chronic pain and muscle tension.

name: Death Bubba
description: A Canadian favorite — Death Bubba crosses Death Star and Bubba Kush for one of the most potently sedating indicas available. Can induce near-comatose relaxation at higher doses. Exceptional medical strain for pain, insomnia, and severe stress.

name: Big Bud
description: A classic Dutch indica bred in the 1980s and winner of multiple Cannabis Cups. Big Bud is named for its enormous, dense buds and delivers a smooth, manageable indica effect — not as sedating as many contemporaries, with pleasant body warmth and mood elevation.

name: White Rhino
description: White Widow's heavier indica cousin. White Rhino takes the legendary White Widow genetics and pushes them toward deeper body relaxation and sedation. Dense with white trichomes like its parent, with earthy and sweet aromas.

name: Banana OG
description: A potent indica-dominant OG cross with one of the most distinctive flavors in cannabis — unmistakable ripe banana sweetness over classic OG earthiness. Banana OG is known for exceptional potency and deeply sedating effects.

name: Mango Kush
description: The perfect marriage of tropical fruit and earthy Kush genetics. Mango Kush smells exactly like fresh mango and delivers a smooth, relaxing body high with mild euphoria. Excellent beginner-friendly indica — not overwhelming but genuinely relaxing.

name: Triangle Kush
description: A legendary Florida OG cut named after Miami, Orlando, and Jacksonville — the 'triangle' of Florida cannabis culture. Triangle Kush is intensely potent with deep sedation and the classic OG aroma of pine and earth. One of the most sought-after OG genetics.

name: True OG
description: One of the most respected OG Kush phenotypes in California. True OG is a nearly pure indica expression of OG genetics — intense pine-lemon aroma with heavy sedation and classic OG euphoria. Steady performer across every quality metric.

name: SFV OG
description: The San Fernando Valley OG — a California classic. SFV OG leans more indica than most OG cuts, delivering a heavy, sedating body high with intense lemon-pine aroma. A cornerstone of LA cannabis culture since the early 2000s.

name: G13
description: The most legendary rumor in cannabis history — supposedly a single cutting from a government cannabis research program in Mississippi. G13 delivers heavy, sedating indica effects with earthy sweetness. Whether the government story is true or not, it's an exceptional strain.

name: Afghan Kush
description: The quintessential Afghan landrace — the original hash plant. Afghan Kush has been used for centuries in hash production across Afghanistan and Pakistan. Heavy, deeply sedating indica effects with rich earthy hash terpenes. Higher CBD than most indicas.

name: Berry White
description: Blueberry meets White Widow — a potent indica-dominant hybrid with blueberry sweetness layered over White Widow's complex resinous depth. Berry White delivers a balanced euphoria that transitions into deep body relaxation. Beautiful trichome production.

name: Black Domina
genetics: Afghan × Northern Lights × Hash Plant × Ortega Indica
description: Four landrace indica genetics combined into one knockout strain. Black Domina is pure indica sedation — fast-acting, powerful, and deeply physical. Used frequently in medical settings for severe pain and insomnia. One of the heaviest indica genetics available.

name: Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: One of the most popular strains of 2023-2025 — Lemon Cherry Gelato combines intense lemon and cherry flavors with elite Cookies genetics. High-THC, beautifully colored, and profoundly euphoric. A top-shelf dispensary staple across the legal market.

name: Gary Payton
description: A Cookies collab with NBA legend Gary Payton. Created by Cookies x Powerzzzup, Gary Payton delivers a sharp, focused euphoria with exceptional terpene complexity. Named after Payton's intense defensive style — this strain hits hard and doesn't let up.

name: Peanut Butter Breath
description: Unmistakably nutty — Peanut Butter Breath has one of the most unique flavor profiles in cannabis. Do-Si-Dos and Mendo Breath combine for a creamy, slightly sweet peanut butter taste with balanced indica-leaning effects. Calming without total sedation.

name: Biscotti
description: Sweet cookie dough and coffee with earthy undertones — Biscotti's flavor is genuinely dessert-like. This Cookies-adjacent hybrid hits hard with euphoric body relaxation and an almost creamy smoothness. A top dispensary seller wherever it's available.

name: Gushers
description: Named after the candy. Gushers delivers explosive tropical fruit flavor from Gelato 41 genetics over Triangle Kush body sedation. An immediate euphoric rush that transitions into full-body relaxation. One of the most flavorful strains of the modern dispensary era.

name: Kush Mints
description: Minty cookies over deep Kush earthiness — Kush Mints has one of the most complex flavor profiles in modern cannabis. Animal Mints and Bubba Kush combine for a potent, balanced hybrid with excellent body relaxation and clean euphoria.

name: Apple Fritter
description: Smells exactly like warm apple fritters from a bakery. Apple Fritter delivers sweet apple and vanilla flavors from top-shelf genetics, with intensely euphoric effects and excellent body relaxation. Consistently one of the highest-rated strains in legal markets.

name: GMO Cookies
description: GMO stands for Garlic, Mushroom, Onion — the savory, funky aroma profile that defines this strain. Also called Garlic Cookies. GMO is intensely potent with a uniquely complex flavor and deep indica-leaning sedation. A polarizing strain: you either love the funk or you don't.

name: Jealousy
description: From Seed Junky Genetics — Jealousy became one of the most sought-after strains of 2022-2024. Complex Sherbet and Gelato genetics deliver sweet, fruity terpenes with a balanced, euphoric body high. Beautiful genetics that consistently impresses.

name: Grease Monkey
description: Gorilla Glue meets Cookies and Cream — a sleepy, relaxing hybrid with vanilla-forward sweetness. Grease Monkey delivers the heavy body sedation of GG4 softened by the creamy sweetness of Cookies and Cream genetics. Perfect for evening relaxation.

name: Papaya
description: From Nirvana Seeds — intensely tropical aroma of fresh papaya and mango. Papaya delivers smooth indica body relaxation with a pleasant, approachable high that doesn't overwhelm. Popular for stress relief and as an afternoon or evening strain.

name: Headband
genetics: OG Kush × Sour Diesel × Master Kush
description: Famous for creating a light pressure sensation around the crown of the head — like wearing a headband. This three-way OG cross delivers a slow-building but intensely euphoric high with great creativity and long duration. A celebrated hybrid with loyal fans.

name: London Pound Cake
description: Named for the British dessert. London Pound Cake from Seed Junky Genetics delivers some of the highest THC numbers regularly found in legal markets. Dense, gassy, berry-sweet buds with deeply sedating indica effects. Heavy hitter for experienced consumers.

name: Motorbreath
genetics: Chemdog × San Fernando Valley OG Kush
description: Chemdog and SFV OG produce one of the gassiest, most pungent profiles in cannabis. Motorbreath has an industrial diesel fuel aroma with deeply sedating effects and exceptional potency. A heavy-hitter favored by experienced consumers for its intensity.

name: Permanent Marker
description: One of the most hyped modern strains — Permanent Marker from Seed Junky Genetics has a jet fuel meets berry candy profile that's instantly recognizable. High THC with deeply euphoric effects that transition into lasting body relaxation. Premium shelf wherever it appears.

name: Mochi
description: Named after the Japanese rice cake. Mochi combines Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies for a dessert-sweet, minty profile with excellent potency. Delivers euphoric body relaxation with social, creative uplift — a well-rounded modern hybrid.

name: Mandarin Cookies
description: Brilliant orange citrus meets Girl Scout Cookies sweetness. Mandarin Cookies delivers a sativa-leaning experience despite hybrid genetics — bright, energetic, and creative. The Limonene-dominant terpene profile drives mood elevation and stress relief.

name: Birthday Cake
description: Cherry Pie and Girl Scout Cookies create a vanilla-sweet, dessert-like profile that lives up to the name. Birthday Cake delivers heavy indica-leaning relaxation with euphoric sweetness. Popular for stress and anxiety relief with a smooth, approachable character.

name: Pink Runtz
description: A pink-tinged phenotype of the Runtz line with a softer, berry-candy profile. Pink Runtz delivers euphoric body relaxation with a smooth, creamy sweetness. More accessible than original Runtz for beginners while still delivering exceptional quality.

name: White Runtz
description: The lightest and highest-THC expression of the Runtz line. White Runtz is coated in white trichomes with an almost crystalline appearance. Sweet tropical candy flavor and euphoric, long-lasting body high. Consistently among the highest-reviewed Runtz phenotypes.

name: Sherb Crasher
description: Sunset Sherbet meets Wedding Crasher for one of the most pleasant flavor profiles in modern cannabis — sweet berry and citrus cream. Sherb Crasher delivers balanced euphoria with body relaxation and an approachable potency level.

name: RS11
description: Rainbow Sherbet #11 — a Doja Exclusive cut that became one of the most sought-after strains of 2022-2024. RS11 has tropical berry sweetness with exceptional potency. Complex, layered flavor that rewards slow appreciation. Premium shelf staple.

name: Blueberry Muffin
description: Exactly what the name suggests — warm blueberry muffin aroma in cannabis form. Blueberry Muffin delivers sweet berry euphoria with smooth indica body relaxation. One of the most approachable and beginner-friendly strains for sweet-flavor lovers.

name: Strawberry Banana
description: From DNA Genetics — Strawberry Banana consistently tests among the highest terpene concentrations in cannabis. Sweet strawberry and banana candy flavor with a long-lasting euphoric body high. One of the most terpene-rich strains ever measured in lab testing.

name: Stardawg
description: A Chemdawg descendant with heavy diesel fuel character and an energetic, cerebral high. Stardawg is popular among cannabis connoisseurs for its intense terpene expression and clear-headed euphoria. Diesel lovers rank it among the best in the category.

name: Grape Pie
description: Sweet grape candy over an earthy pie base. Grape Pie delivers a well-balanced euphoric high that gradually transitions into body relaxation. Popular in California and Colorado dispensaries for its distinctive flavor and consistent quality.

name: UK Cheese
description: The original from the UK — a Skunk #1 phenotype with a deeply pungent cheese aroma that shocked British cannabis culture in the 1990s. UK Cheese delivers a pleasant, balanced high with excellent creative energy. Still widely loved in the UK and increasingly popular globally.

name: Blue Cheese
description: UK Cheese genetics meet Blueberry sweetness — one of the most surprisingly pleasant flavor combinations in cannabis. Blue Cheese smooths out the pungent cheese with fruity blueberry notes and delivers indica-leaning relaxation with creative euphoria.

name: Dutch Treat
description: A Dutch classic — popular in Amsterdam coffeeshops for decades. Dutch Treat delivers a balanced, clear-headed high that's pleasant and approachable. Sweet pine and earthy aromas with good creative energy and social uplift. Excellent choice for daytime.

name: Watermelon Zkittlez
description: Watermelon candy meets Zkittlez tropical sweetness — an exceptionally sweet, fruit-forward hybrid. Watermelon Zkittlez delivers euphoric body relaxation with the candy-sweet flavor profile that made Zkittlez famous, amplified by watermelon notes.

name: Banana Punch
description: Banana OG and Purple Punch combine their exceptional flavor profiles — banana cream meets grape punch. Banana Punch delivers a smooth, euphoric indica-leaning high with outstanding tropical sweetness. One of the most flavorful evening strains available.

name: Skunk #1
description: The granddaddy of modern hybrid breeding. Skunk #1 from Sensi Seeds changed cannabis forever in the 1980s — it's in the genetic lineage of hundreds of modern strains. Delivers a classic, balanced high that's euphoric, social, and endlessly versatile.

name: Venom OG
description: A Rare Dankness creation with intense OG character — lemon, pine, and earthy diesel tones with a heavy, sedating body effect. Venom OG is a potent evening strain for experienced consumers who want OG genetics at their most intense.

name: Orange Cookies
description: Bright orange citrus meets Girl Scout Cookies sweetness. Orange Cookies delivers a sativa-leaning euphoria with social energy and creative uplift. The citrus terpene profile makes it one of the most mood-elevating cookie-family strains available.

name: Trop Cherry
description: Tropicana Cookies meets Cherry Pie — a beautiful combination of tropical citrus and cherry sweetness. Trop Cherry delivers energetic euphoria with excellent creative uplift and a balanced, manageable effect profile. Colorful, aromatic, and consistently impressive.

name: Layer Cake
description: Wedding Cake meets GMO — dessert sweetness crossed with gassy funk. Layer Cake builds on two of the most popular modern genetics for a deeply euphoric, heavily sedating hybrid. The layered flavor complexity lives up to the name.

name: Sour Tangie
description: Sour Diesel and Tangie combine their signature citrus and diesel profiles for an intensely sour, tangy hybrid. Sour Tangie delivers energetic, creative sativa-leaning effects with exceptional terpene complexity. Beloved by terpene enthusiasts.

name: Blueberry Diesel
description: Blueberry sweetness over Diesel fuel — an unusual but excellent combination. Blueberry Diesel delivers a balanced high that's both euphoric and relaxing, with creative energy that makes it a solid choice for afternoon use. Popular among hybrid lovers.

name: Alien Dawg
description: Alien Kush and Chemdawg combine for a uniquely complex chemical-earth profile. Alien Dawg delivers a deep, slow-building euphoria with significant body relaxation. Favored by cannabis connoisseurs who appreciate complex diesel-forward genetics.

name: Champagne Kush
description: A celebratory Kush with floral, slightly sweet aromatics unlike typical OG strains. Champagne Kush delivers smooth euphoria with gentle body relaxation — elegant and approachable. Popular for social occasions and creative work.

name: Banana Split
description: Tangie's citrus meets Banana Sherbet's fruity sweetness — an incredibly tropical, dessert-like experience. Banana Split delivers uplifting euphoria with creative energy and a smooth, balanced body effect. One of the most pleasant all-day strains.

name: Black Mamba
description: Dark as its namesake. Black Mamba combines Granddaddy Purple and Black Domina for deep purple coloring and intensely sedating effects. Rich grape and berry sweetness with powerful indica body sedation — a nighttime strain for experienced users.

name: Gorilla Cookies
description: Gorilla Glue's legendary potency meets the flavor of Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. Gorilla Cookies delivers a powerful, glue-like body effect with cookie sweetness. Fast-acting and intensely euphoric — one of the most reliable high-potency hybrids.

name: Lemon Runtz
description: Runtz genetics with an amplified lemon citrus profile. Lemon Runtz delivers the characteristic Runtz euphoria and body relaxation with a brighter, more citrus-forward flavor experience. Excellent mood elevator with balanced body effects.

name: Peach Ringz
description: Named after the iconic candy. Peach Ringz delivers sweet peach candy flavor with indica-leaning body relaxation and euphoric mood elevation. The unmistakable peach aroma makes it one of the most recognizable fruit-forward hybrids in dispensaries.

name: Charlotte's Web
description: The strain that changed the national conversation about cannabis. Charlotte's Web was developed for Charlotte Figi, a young girl with Dravet syndrome, and became famous after a CNN documentary. Near-zero THC with 17%+ CBD — used for epilepsy, inflammation, and anxiety without any psychoactive effect.

name: Harlequin
genetics: Colombian Gold × Thai × Swiss Landrace × Nepali Indica
description: One of the most popular high-CBD strains in dispensaries. Harlequin maintains a reliable 5:2 CBD:THC ratio — enough THC for mild euphoria but CBD-dominant enough to remain functional and clear-headed. Excellent for pain, anxiety, and daytime medical use without intoxication.

name: ACDC
description: One of the highest-CBD, lowest-THC strains ever developed. ACDC averages 20:1 CBD:THC — virtually no psychoactive effect. Developed for severe epilepsy, PTSD, and MS. A transformative strain for patients who need cannabis medicine without any impairment.

name: Cannatonic
description: The strain that launched the high-CBD movement in cannabis. Cannatonic maintains roughly a 1:1 THC:CBD ratio, delivering a mild, manageable high with strong CBD modulation. Excellent for anxiety, muscle spasms, and pain — widely used as a medical baseline.

name: White Fire OG
description: Also known as WiFi OG. The White and Fire OG genetics combine for one of the most cerebral and creative sativa-leaning hybrids available. White Fire OG delivers an intense, clear-headed euphoria with excellent focus and creative energy — popular with artists and professionals.

name: Platinum OG
genetics: Master Kush × OG Kush × Unknown Third
description: A premium OG triple-cross with slow-building but deeply sedating effects. Platinum OG is known for powerful body relaxation and long duration — effects can last 3-4 hours. A popular evening strain for consumers who want extended relief.

name: LA Kush Cake
description: Kush Mints crossed with Wedding Cake — a premium Los Angeles hybrid with minty vanilla dessert flavor and potent indica-leaning effects. LA Kush Cake has become a staple of high-end California dispensaries with consistent quality and strong body effects.

name: Grape Diamonds
description: Grape Pie's fruity sweetness over Diamond OG's gassy potency. Grape Diamonds delivers a rich, berry-sweet flavor with deeply relaxing indica effects. The combination of fruit and OG genetics makes for a uniquely satisfying evening strain.

name: Sour Grape
description: Sour Diesel's cerebral rush meets Granddaddy Purple's grape sweetness in an unusual but excellent combination. Sour Grape delivers energetic euphoria alongside body relaxation — a genuinely balanced hybrid that satisfies both sativa and indica preferences.

name: Cookies and Cream
description: Vanilla cream and sweet cookie flavor in cannabis form. Cookies and Cream won 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup and consistently impresses for its dessert-like terpene profile and balanced, euphoric body high. Approachable potency with excellent flavor.

name: Herijuana
description: One of the most intensely sedating indicas ever produced. Herijuana from Woodhorse Seeds is an extremely heavy, couch-locking indica developed for medicinal use. The deep earthy-hash aroma and near-comatose body effect make it one of the strongest indicas in existence.

name: Tangilope
description: Chocolope's chocolate notes meet Tangie's orange citrus in an unexpected combination. Tangilope delivers sativa-leaning creative energy with a complex, layered flavor profile. A fun daytime strain with excellent mood elevation.

name: Mango
description: A classic indica from KC Brains with an unmistakably tropical mango aroma — one of the original fruit-flavored cannabis strains. Delivers smooth, manageable relaxation with mood elevation and appetite stimulation. A beginner-friendly evening strain.

name: Pancakes
description: Kush Cake and Biscotti create a genuinely breakfast-like aroma — sweet, buttery, and warm. Pancakes delivers excellent indica-leaning relaxation with euphoric sweetness and a smooth, lasting effect. A premium modern hybrid with serious dispensary presence.

name: Honey Bun
description: Sweet honey and vanilla dessert flavor with high THC and deeply euphoric effects. Honey Bun is a modern premium hybrid from select California and Colorado cultivators — consistent top-shelf quality with a uniquely warm, sweet profile.

name: Purple Trainwreck
description: Trainwreck's energetic rush with Mendocino purple strain body effects and grape sweetness. Purple Trainwreck delivers a powerful burst of creative euphoria that gradually mellows into relaxation — the best of both worlds for hybrid lovers.

name: Raspberry Cough
description: Sweet raspberry candy aroma with uplifting sativa-leaning effects. Raspberry Cough follows in Strawberry Cough's tradition of supremely flavorful, mood-elevating fruit strains. Delivers bright euphoria and social energy with a beautifully sweet smoke.

name: Limoncello
description: Italian dessert liqueur in cannabis form. Limoncello delivers intense lemon-cream flavor with bright, uplifting euphoria and balanced body relaxation. A premium modern strain appearing increasingly in top-tier dispensaries.

name: Thai
description: One of the original landrace sativas from Southeast Asia, Thai delivers a soaring, psychedelic cerebral high that fueled the creative counterculture of the 1970s. Expect a sweet, earthy, and slightly spicy aroma with long-lasting, energetic euphoria.

name: Mexican Sativa
description: A classic landrace from the highlands of Mexico, this strain offers a light, uplifting buzz perfect for social situations and creative endeavors. Its aroma is earthy and herbal with subtle citrus notes.

name: Malawi Gold
description: Hailing from the Malawi region of Africa, this legendary landrace is prized for its long, golden buds and soaring sativa effects. The high is euphoric, clear-headed, and lasting — great for deep focus or artistic flow.

name: Swazi Gold
description: A golden sativa from the mountains of Swaziland in southern Africa. Swazi Gold produces a happy, uplifting high with a gentle, long-lasting energetic buzz. Its flavor profile is earthy, fruity, and subtly sweet.

name: Nepalese
description: A Himalayan landrace from Nepal, this strain is one of the most revered in the world of hash-making. Its effect is cerebral and uplifting with a dreamy, floaty quality. Aroma is earthy, floral, and slightly spicy.

name: Kilimanjaro
description: An East African landrace from the slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro. This powerful sativa is known for delivering an energetic, euphoric rush with strong cerebral effects and a sweet, fruity aroma.

name: Original Haze
description: The legendary progenitor of virtually every haze variety in existence. Original Haze delivers an intense, psychedelic, long-lasting cerebral high with a complex spicy-earthy-citrus aroma. Not for beginners.

name: Silver Haze
description: A Silver Haze cross that delivers the classic haze experience with a slightly more manageable intensity. Crystal-coated buds produce a sharp, spicy-citrus aroma and an electric, euphoric head high.

name: Blue Haze
description: A beautiful cross of Blueberry and Haze that tempers the haze's intensity with the indica sweetness of Blueberry. Expect a balanced, blissful euphoria with a sweet berry aroma and a long, pleasant high.

name: Strawberry Haze
description: Strawberry Haze brings together the fruity sweetness of Strawberry Cough with the electric energy of Haze genetics. The result is a vibrant, uplifting strain with a striking sweet-strawberry aroma and a long-lasting head high.

name: Mango Haze
description: A tropical take on classic Haze genetics, Mango Haze smells exactly as its name suggests — ripe mango with spicy haze undertones. Its effect is energetic and euphoric, perfect for a productive or creative day.

name: Shiva Haze
description: Named after the Hindu deity of transformation, Shiva Haze delivers a mind-bending, uplifting cerebral experience. This potent sativa is not for the faint of heart — it hits fast with euphoric energy and a complex herbal, citrus aroma.

name: Amnesia
description: A legendary Amsterdam coffee shop staple, Amnesia hits hard with an intensely euphoric, psychedelic rush that can overwhelm inexperienced users. Its complex aroma blends earthy, lemony, and spicy notes into something truly unforgettable.

name: Pineapple Haze
description: Pineapple Haze merges the tropical sweetness of Pineapple with the cerebral energy of Haze. The result is a bright, happy, and motivating strain with a juicy pineapple-citrus aroma that brightens any mood.

name: G13 Haze
description: The legendary G13 government indica crossed with a Haze sativa creates a powerful hybrid with the best of both worlds. Expect heavy, stoney body relaxation wrapped in a euphoric, cerebral buzz, backed by a complex earthy-spicy aroma.

name: Grapefruit Haze
description: A bright, citrusy sativa that blends Grapefruit's tangy sweetness with Haze's electric energy. The aroma is unmistakably citrus-forward with a sharp grapefruit bite and an effect that's uplifting, social, and mood-boosting.

name: Ghost OG
description: Ghost OG is one of the most celebrated OG cuts, prized for its exceptional resin production and intense citrus-pine aroma. The high is powerfully euphoric and relaxing, melting away stress and pain while keeping the mind clear enough to function.

name: Lemon OG Kush
description: Lemon OG brings a bright citrus twist to classic OG Kush genetics. Sharp lemon zest over earthy, piney OG base notes create a distinctive aroma. The effect is a relaxed but uplifting experience, ideal for stress relief with mental clarity.

name: Diablo OG
description: Diablo OG is a potent, fast-hitting OG cross that delivers a heavy, sedating body effect paired with a deep, euphoric head high. Its aroma is pungently earthy and piney with diesel undertones — classic OG character turned up to 11.

name: Obama Kush
description: Obama Kush is a deeply relaxing indica with a smooth, sweet flavor profile and mellow, stress-melting effects. Named for its presidential-grade quality, it delivers full body calm and gentle euphoria — perfect for unwinding after a long day.

name: Presidential OG
description: Presidential OG lives up to its name with a powerful, full-body sedation and a supremely relaxing effect. This is a heavy indica best reserved for evening use. Its aroma is rich, earthy, and piney with a smooth, almost creamy smoke.

name: Lemon Kush
description: Lemon Kush delivers a perfect balance of kush relaxation and bright citrus energy. The lemon aroma is sharp and clean, while the effect is gently euphoric and body-relaxing without putting you to sleep. Great for daytime stress relief.

name: Kandy Kush
description: Kandy Kush is a cross of OG Kush and Trainwreck, delivering a sweet, candy-like aroma with potent indica relaxation. The high is deeply physical and euphoric, easing tension and melting into pleasant sleepiness.

name: Candy Kush
description: A sweet, dessert-like hybrid that combines the relaxing qualities of kush genetics with a candy-sweet flavor that's hard to resist. Candy Kush offers a gentle, happy buzz perfect for social settings or winding down.

name: Hash Plant
description: A classic indica bred specifically for resin production and hash-making. Hash Plant delivers a deeply sedating, heavy body high with an intensely earthy, dank, and almost hashy aroma. This is a couch-lock indica through and through.

name: Grape Kush
description: Grape Kush is a fragrant indica with a deep, sweet grape aroma that carries into a smooth, berry-sweet smoke. The effect is classic indica — full-body relaxation and a calm, euphoric mood. Great for evening pain or insomnia relief.

name: Strawberry Kush
description: Strawberry Kush combines the sweetness of Strawberry Cough with the heavy relaxation of OG Kush. The result is a pleasantly aromatic hybrid with a strawberry-sweet flavor and balanced effect — uplifting at first, then drifting into mellow relaxation.

name: Blueberry Kush
description: Blueberry Kush is a sweet, aromatic indica cross of Blueberry and OG Kush. Its deep blueberry aroma and smooth berry flavor make it one of the more enjoyable pure indicas. The effect is deeply relaxing with a happy, euphoric undertone.

name: Cotton Candy Kush
description: Cotton Candy Kush is a playfully sweet hybrid with an aroma reminiscent of, well, cotton candy. Its effect is light and euphoric with gentle body relaxation — an easygoing, fun strain that's great for social occasions.

name: East Coast Sour Diesel
description: The original East Coast Sour D is the gold standard diesel sativa — fuel, citrus, and chemical aromas explode from the bag before you even open it. The effect is famously euphoric, energizing, and cerebral, beloved by creatives and professionals alike.

name: Strawberry Diesel
description: Strawberry Diesel bridges the gap between fruity and fuel, combining the sweet strawberry aromas of Strawberry Cough with the energetic rush of Sour Diesel. A perfectly balanced hybrid that tastes great and hits even better.

name: Lemon Diesel
description: Lemon Diesel takes diesel genetics and drenches them in citrus. The result is a sharp, lemony strain with serious fuel undertones and a clear-headed, energizing effect that's great for daytime productivity.

name: Blue Diesel
description: Blue Diesel blends the sweet blueberry notes of Blueberry with the fuel punch of NYC Diesel. The result is a well-balanced hybrid with a pleasant, sweet-diesel aroma and an easy, happy buzz that's not too overpowering.

name: Banana Diesel
description: Banana Diesel is a head-turning combination of tropical banana sweetness and the sharp, energizing kick of diesel. The nose is remarkably fruity with a fuel accent, and the effect is uplifting and euphoric with relaxing body notes.

name: Headband OG
description: Headband OG gets its name from the characteristic pressure users feel around their forehead and temples — a telltale sign of its potency. A cross of OG Kush and Sour Diesel, it delivers a slow-building, creeping euphoria with heavy relaxation.

name: Original Cheese
description: The original Cheese clone from the UK that started a global movement. Its unmistakable pungent, sharp cheese aroma is unlike anything else in cannabis. The effect is uplifting and euphoric with a solid indica relaxation — a true classic.

name: Big Buddha Cheese
description: Big Buddha Cheese is an award-winning phenotype of Cheese that has won multiple Cannabis Cups. It retains the sharp cheese aroma but adds a sweeter edge and a more balanced effect — euphoric, happy, and relaxing without being sedating.

name: Exodus Cheese
description: Exodus Cheese is the legendary original Skunk #1 phenotype that evolved into what the UK calls 'Cheese.' Its uniquely funky, skunky-cheese aroma is a cannabis cultural touchstone. The effect is happy, uplifting, and enduringly popular.

name: Cheese Quake
description: Cheese Quake is a cross of Cheese and Querkle that delivers a funky, berry-grape aroma over the classic Cheese base. The effect is a euphoric, relaxing hybrid that hits both body and mind with equal force.

name: Thin Mint GSC
description: The Thin Mint cut of Girl Scout Cookies is arguably the most coveted phenotype — its cool, minty undertones layered over the classic GSC sweetness are unforgettable. Dense, resin-drenched buds deliver a euphoric, body-heavy high.

name: Animal Mints
description: Animal Mints is an extraordinarily potent cross of Animal Cookies and SinMint Cookies. Its minty, fuel-like aroma is distinctive and the effect is intensely euphoric and physically heavy — not for beginners. One of the most terpene-rich modern hybrids.

name: Wookies
description: Wookies is a cross of Girl Scout Cookies, White 91, and The White — a resin monster with a complex, sweet-earthy aroma and an intensely euphoric, body-relaxing high. Covered in so many trichomes it almost looks white.

name: Pink Cookies
description: Also known as Wedding Cake, Pink Cookies is a cross of Triangle Kush and Animal Mints that delivers a rich, vanilla-sweet aroma and a powerful, balanced high. Euphoric and relaxing with a dessert-like flavor profile.

name: Sunset Cookies
description: Sunset Cookies is a warm, dessert-forward hybrid with sweet orange and vanilla notes over a cookie base. The effect is a happy, mellow euphoria that winds into gentle body relaxation — ideal for evenings.

name: Georgia Pie
description: Georgia Pie is a Seed Junky cross of Gelatti and Kush Mints that smells like a fresh Georgia peach with undertones of cream and earth. The high is fast-acting and euphoric, settling into deep body relaxation. Extremely sought-after in the modern exotic market.

name: Premium Jack
description: Premium Jack is an elite phenotype of Jack Herer with enhanced resin production and a sharper, spicier terpene profile. It retains the classic Jack Herer experience — clear-headed creativity, energy, and focus — but turned up a notch.

name: Gelato 33
description: Gelato 33, also known as 'Larry Bird,' is perhaps the most iconic Gelato cut. This balanced hybrid smells of dessert and berries with a smooth, sweet flavor and a powerful, full-body euphoria that keeps the mind lucid. A modern benchmark strain.

name: Gelato 41
description: Gelato 41, or 'Bacio,' is one of the top Gelato cuts from the Cookies Family. Known for enormous trichome coverage, its aroma is intensely sweet with berry and earthy undertones. The effect is a powerful, euphoric, body-relaxing high.

name: Gelato 45
description: Gelato 45 is a premium Gelato phenotype prized for its creamy, dessert flavor and well-rounded high. Its terpene profile delivers a sweet, minty-berry aroma and the effect is simultaneously relaxing and mentally uplifting.

name: Bacio Gelato
description: Bacio is Gelato 41's other name and is among the most decorated Gelato cuts. Its name means 'kiss' in Italian, fitting for a strain this smooth and sweet. Dense, trichome-packed buds deliver a rich, creamy berry taste and a heavy euphoric high.

name: Dolato
description: Dolato is a cross of Do-Si-Dos and Gelato 41, combining two of the most potent strains on the market. The result is a deeply relaxing, euphoric hybrid with a sweet, cookie-berry aroma and exceptionally heavy resin production.

name: Gelato Cake
description: Gelato Cake is a cross of Gelato 33 and Wedding Cake — two modern legends in one. Its aroma is a rich blend of sweet cream, vanilla, and berries. The high is intensely euphoric and relaxing, with serious couch-lock potential.

name: Sherbet OG
description: Sherbet OG (or Pink Panties × Sunset Sherbet) delivers a fruity, creamy sweetness backed by OG Kush earthiness. The effect is a euphoric, relaxed, and sociable high that's perfect for unwinding without full sedation.

name: Mango Sherbet
description: Mango Sherbet is a tropical, fruity hybrid that tastes as vibrant as it sounds. Ripe mango meets the creamy sweetness of Sherbet genetics for a strain that's both delicious and gently euphoric. Great for relaxed daytime use.

name: Orange Sherbet
description: Orange Sherbet delivers a burst of fresh citrus and creamy sweetness reminiscent of an orange creamsicle. Its effect is uplifting and happy with a gentle body relaxation — a perfect daytime treat for mood elevation.

name: Raspberry Sherbet
description: Raspberry Sherbet is a fruity, sweet hybrid with a bright raspberry aroma and creamy undertones. Its effect is gently euphoric and relaxing — uplifting enough for daytime but smooth enough for evenings.

name: Peach Sherbet
description: Peach Sherbet captures the essence of a ripe, juicy peach with cream and sweet citrus undertones. This pleasant hybrid delivers a happy, balanced high that's great for social settings or relaxed creative activities.

name: Tropical Runtz
description: Tropical Runtz takes the candy-sweet Runtz base and pushes it into exotic, tropical fruit territory. Think mango, papaya, and passionfruit layered over sweet candy on the exhale. The effect is euphoric, uplifting, and relaxing.

name: Watermelon Runtz
description: Watermelon Runtz smells like a watermelon Jolly Rancher — sweet, fresh, and irresistible. This Runtz phenotype delivers the classic Runtz euphoria with a distinctly fruity, watermelon-candy twist.

name: Rainbow Runtz
description: Rainbow Runtz is a vibrant, multi-layered Runtz phenotype with a complex candy-fruit aroma that shifts as you smell it. Its effect is powerfully euphoric and relaxing — a genuinely happy strain that lives up to its colorful name.

name: Banana Runtz
description: Banana Runtz combines Runtz's candy sweetness with Banana's tropical, creamy notes. The aroma is ripe banana and sweet cream candy — distinctively dessert-like. The effect is a euphoric, relaxing hybrid high.

name: Purple Runtz
description: Purple Runtz brings the classic candy-sweet Runtz profile together with deep grape and berry notes. The buds are often purple-hued, the aroma is fruity-sweet candy, and the effect is a balanced, euphoric relaxation.

name: Grape Runtz
description: Grape Runtz is a phenotype that emphasizes the grape and berry side of Runtz genetics. Deep, sweet grape candy aroma with earthy undertones and a relaxed, happy euphoric effect.

name: Peach Runtz
description: Peach Runtz is a delicious Runtz phenotype with a peachy, sweet-candy aroma that makes it instantly appealing. The high is uplifting and euphoric with a mellow body relaxation — great for afternoon use.

name: Runtz OG
description: Runtz OG takes the Runtz candy profile and grounds it with OG Kush's earthy, piney depth. The result is a more complex, robust Runtz experience with the same euphoric, relaxing effect but with added depth of flavor.

name: Grape Zkittlez
description: Grape Zkittlez pushes Zkittlez genetics toward deep grape and berry territory. Dense, fragrant buds deliver a candy-grape aroma with an uplifting, relaxed effect that mirrors the taste of grape candy.

name: Melon Zkittlez
description: Melon Zkittlez expresses the tropical, melon side of the Zkittlez family. Sweet, juicy watermelon and honeydew aromas with earthy undertones. Effect is calming, happy, and mellow.

name: Rainbow Belts
description: Rainbow Belts (Zkittlez × Moonbow) is a stunningly fruity hybrid with a candy-sweet aroma reminiscent of rainbow belt candy. Exceptionally terpy buds produce a balanced, euphoric high with strong body relaxation.

name: Wedding Pie
description: Wedding Pie is a cross of Wedding Cake and Grape Pie that results in a gloriously sweet, tangy strain. Its aroma blends wedding cake vanilla with grape candy for an irresistible combination. The effect is deeply relaxing and euphoric.

name: Triangle Mints
description: Triangle Mints (Triangle Kush × Animal Mints) is a terpene powerhouse with a complex minty, earthy, and fuel-forward aroma. This heavy hybrid delivers intense euphoria followed by serious body sedation — reserve for experienced users.

name: Cherry Cake
description: Cherry Cake is a mouthwatering hybrid with a sweet cherry dessert aroma backed by vanilla and earth. A perfect evening strain that delivers pleasant euphoria and body relaxation with a flavor that sticks with you.

name: Blueberry Cake
description: Blueberry Cake combines the sweet berry genetics of Blueberry with the rich dessert profile of Wedding Cake. The result is a sweet, berry-forward hybrid that delivers euphoric relaxation and a mouthwatering flavor.

name: Cake Pop
description: Cake Pop is a Seed Junky creation crossing Wedding Cake and Lemon Bean. Its aroma is sweet lemon cake with earthy undertones, and the effect is a balanced, euphoric high with full-body relaxation.

name: Oreoz
description: Oreoz (Oreo Cookies × Secret Weapon) is one of the most potent modern hybrids, routinely testing over 30% THC. Its aroma is of dark chocolate, cookie, and diesel with a rich, dessert-like flavor. The high is intensely euphoric, creative, and physically sedating.

name: Zoap
description: Zoap (Rainbow Belts × Zkittlez) is a vibrant, aromatic hybrid with an extraordinary tropical candy aroma and stunning bag appeal. Its effect is euphoric and uplifting, settling into a comfortable body relaxation — a top-shelf modern exotic.

name: Apples and Bananas
description: Apples and Bananas is a Compound Genetics masterpiece combining Platinum Cookies × Granddaddy Purple × Blue Power × Gelatti. Extremely potent and uniquely aromatic, it smells exactly as its name suggests — fresh apples and ripe bananas. A collector's strain.

name: Ice Cream Man
description: Ice Cream Man (Legends OG × Jet Fuel Gelato) is a dessert-forward hybrid with a creamy, vanilla ice cream aroma and a fuel undercurrent. The high is full-body euphoric relaxation with a dreamy, uplifting mental state.

name: Jokerz
description: Jokerz is a Compound Genetics strain (White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato) with a candy-sweet, fruity aroma and serious potency. Its euphoric, mentally stimulating high transitions into deep body relaxation — a strain that keeps you guessing.

name: Grapes and Cream
description: Grapes and Cream is a luscious indica-dominant hybrid with a rich grape candy and cream aroma. Its smooth, sweet flavor leads into a deeply relaxing, euphoric body high that's perfect for unwinding.

name: Grape Cream Cake
description: Grape Cream Cake combines Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Koolato genetics for a dessert lover's dream. Its aroma is rich grape candy with sweet cream and vanilla, and the effect is a deep, sedating euphoria.

name: Frozen Grapes
description: Frozen Grapes is a frosty, terpene-rich hybrid with a distinct grape and sweet berry aroma. Its name references both its flavor and its extraordinary trichome coverage. The effect is euphoric and gently sedating.

name: Grape Gasoline
description: Grape Gasoline is a head-turning combination of deep grape sweetness and sharp fuel/diesel notes. This unusual pairing creates a complex aroma and a powerful, fast-hitting euphoric high with indica body weight.

name: Lemon Cherry Cookies
description: Lemon Cherry Cookies layers the bright citrus of lemon with sweet cherry and cookie undertones. A tangy-sweet, complex aroma leads into a euphoric, happy, and relaxed high — the kind of strain that disappears from dispensary shelves fast.

name: Purple Lemonade
description: Purple Lemonade is a visually stunning hybrid with deep purple hues and a tart, citrus-lemonade aroma. Its effect is uplifting and creative, with a euphoric social buzz and gentle body relaxation.

name: Runtz Muffin
description: Runtz Muffin is an Barneys Farm cross with an incredible baked goods aroma — think blueberry muffin meets candy. Potent and flavorful, it delivers a long-lasting euphoric high with strong body relaxation.

name: Super Boof
description: Super Boof (Black Cherry Gelato × Tropicana Cookies) is a powerhouse modern hybrid with exceptional flavor and potency. Its aroma is cherry, tropical fruit, and cookies — and the high is intensely euphoric, creative, and physically relaxing.

name: Gastro Pop
description: Gastro Pop (Apples and Bananas × Grape Gas) is an Airfield Supply Company × Compound Genetics collaboration with a complex, layered fruity aroma — think tropical fruit punch. Extremely potent and terpy, it delivers a euphoric, body-relaxing high.

name: Ringo's Gift
description: Ringo's Gift is named after Lawrence Ringo, one of the pioneers of high-CBD cannabis breeding. It has an exceptional CBD:THC ratio, delivering gentle, clear-headed relaxation with potent anti-anxiety and anti-inflammatory effects without intoxication.

name: Harle-Tsu
description: Harle-Tsu is a cross of Harlequin and Sour Tsunami with one of the highest CBD:THC ratios available. Virtually non-intoxicating, it provides powerful anti-inflammatory and anxiolytic effects perfect for daytime medical use.

name: Sour Tsunami
description: Sour Tsunami was one of the first strains specifically bred for high CBD. Created by Lawrence Ringo, it delivers significant therapeutic benefit with mild psychoactive effects — great for pain, inflammation, and anxiety management.

name: Stephen Hawking Kush
description: Stephen Hawking Kush is a high-CBD indica strain with a gentle, calming effect. Named in honor of the physicist, it combines the therapeutic benefits of CBD with mild indica relaxation — excellent for pain, spasms, and sleep.

name: Valentine X
description: Valentine X is an extremely high-CBD strain named for Saint Valentine, patron saint of epilepsy. With a CBD:THC ratio often exceeding 25:1, it provides powerful neurological and anti-inflammatory benefits with virtually no psychoactive effect.

name: Sensi Star
description: Sensi Star is a multiple Cannabis Cup winner from Paradise Seeds. This pure indica is renowned for its potency, stunning resin coverage, and deeply relaxing, almost narcotic body high with sweet, earthy flavors.

name: Shishkaberry
description: Shishkaberry (DJ Short Blueberry × Afghani) is a BC-bred indica with a spectacular blueberry-fruit aroma and a deeply relaxing, sedating effect. Its berries-and-earth flavor is exceptional and the high is long-lasting.

name: Sweet Tooth
description: Sweet Tooth is a BC Seeds creation that won the High Times Cannabis Cup in 2001. This indica-dominant strain has a uniquely sweet, candy-like aroma and produces a mellow, happy high that's relaxing without heavy sedation.

name: Mendo Purps
description: Mendo Purps comes from the legendary Mendocino County cannabis region of Northern California. This purple, aromatic indica delivers a relaxing, euphoric high with a complex grape and berry aroma — a California classic.

name: Querkle
description: Querkle (Purple Urkle × Space Queen) is a stunning purple indica with dense, grape-colored buds and a rich berry-grape aroma. Its effect is deeply sedating and euphoric — a nighttime indica for serious relaxation.

name: Space Queen
description: Space Queen (Romulan × Cinderella 99) is a hard-hitting hybrid from BC's Subcool Seeds. Its sweet, fruity aroma of cherry and vanilla is backed by an intensely euphoric, energetic, and creative high — a true head-stash strain.

name: Snow White
description: Snow White is a White Widow phenotype known for heavy resin production and a clear, euphoric high. Its appearance lives up to the name — pure white trichomes covering dense buds. The effect is uplifting and sociable.

name: XJ-13
description: XJ-13 is a Jack Herer × G13 Haze cross with an exceptionally citrus-forward aroma and balanced, uplifting effect. This California classic delivers creative focus and uplifted mood without anxiety — a perfect functional sativa.

name: Island Sweet Skunk
description: Island Sweet Skunk (ISS) is a beloved Canadian sativa with a tropical, sweet-skunky aroma and a bright, energetic effect. Great for daytime use, socializing, and outdoor activities — it brings out the smiles.

name: The White
description: The White is one of the most resin-covered strains in existence — buds are so coated in trichomes they appear white. Interestingly, it has almost no detectable aroma. Its effect is a powerfully balanced hybrid high, and it's used extensively as a breeding tool.

name: C99
description: Cinderella 99, also known as C99 or Cindy, is a Brothers Grimm classic with a sweet pineapple-mango aroma and an intensely cerebral, euphoric effect. Fast-acting and thought-provoking, it's a legendary sativa head-stash strain.

name: Super Skunk
description: Super Skunk is a Skunk #1 × Afghani cross from Sensi Seeds that amplifies the classic skunky aroma and adds indica body weight. A dependable, classic strain with a strong, pungent smell and a relaxing, happy effect.

name: Skunk Berry
description: Skunk Berry blends the pungent skunkiness of Skunk genetics with sweet, berry-forward flavors. An unusual and pleasant combination that delivers a euphoric, relaxed hybrid effect.

name: Blueberry Headband
description: Blueberry Headband combines the sweet blueberry notes of Blueberry with the potent Headband genetics. Users report the classic headband pressure with a sweet berry aroma and a balanced, long-lasting euphoric effect.

name: Blueberry OG
description: Blueberry OG merges the sweet berry genetics of Blueberry with OG Kush's earthy, piney depth. The result is a deeply relaxing hybrid with a gorgeous blueberry and earth aroma and a euphoric, heavy body effect.

name: Cherry Berry
description: Cherry Berry is a flavorful hybrid with a sweet cherry and mixed berry aroma that's hard to resist. Its effect is gently euphoric and relaxing — a pleasant, easy-going strain for evenings.

name: Blackberry OG
description: Blackberry OG combines Blackberry Kush genetics with classic OG for a strain with deep berry sweetness backed by earthy, piney OG character. Its effect is relaxing and euphoric — a classic evening hybrid.

name: Papaya Cake
description: Papaya Cake (Papaya × Wedding Cake) is a tropical dessert hybrid with a juicy papaya and sweet vanilla aroma. Dense, resinous buds deliver a euphoric, deeply relaxing effect — a vacation in a joint.

name: Papaya Punch
description: Papaya Punch (Papaya × Purple Punch) is a tropical indica-leaning hybrid with stunning purple hues and a fruity papaya-grape aroma. Its effect is relaxing and euphoric with smooth body sedation.

name: Pineapple Kush
description: Pineapple Kush blends the tropical sweetness of Pineapple Express with classic kush relaxation. The result is a smooth, sweet-tasting hybrid that's great for daytime use — uplifting without overwhelming.

name: Guava Cake
description: Guava Cake is a Seed Junky Genetics creation that blends exotic guava tropicality with Wedding Cake's sweet creaminess. Extraordinary terpene expression — it smells exactly like fresh guava. Effect is euphoric and deeply relaxing.

name: Mango Tango
description: Mango Tango is a tropical sativa-leaning hybrid with an overwhelmingly mango-citrus aroma. Its effect is energetic, creative, and uplifting — perfect for a tropical mindset and outdoor activities.

name: Peach OG
description: Peach OG combines ripe peach sweetness with OG Kush's earthy, piney backbone. This pleasant hybrid delivers a sweet, fruity aroma and a balanced effect — uplifting euphoria settling into gentle body relaxation.

name: Gushers OG
description: Gushers OG (Gelato 41 × Triangle Kush) is one of the more popular Cookie Family strains, delivering a tropical fruit candy aroma and a powerfully euphoric, body-heavy effect. Named for the fruity candy — and it delivers.

name: Jet Fuel
description: Jet Fuel (also called G6) is a Aspen OG × High Country Diesel cross with a sharp, diesel-forward aroma and rocket-fuel energy. The effect hits hard and fast — euphoric, energizing, and mentally clear with little body sedation.

name: Garlic Breath
description: Garlic Breath (Chemdog D × Motor Breath) is intentionally pungent — its garlic, fuel, and earth aroma is an acquired taste. But the effect is exceptional: deep, full-body relaxation with a powerful, euphoric mental high.

name: Biscotti Cake
description: Biscotti Cake combines the nutty, sweet Biscotti genetics with Wedding Cake's vanilla richness. An extraordinarily flavorful dessert strain with a powerful euphoric and relaxing effect — one of the finest hybrids for flavor lovers.

name: Kush Mintz
description: Kush Mintz (Animal Mints × Bubba Kush) is an incredibly potent hybrid with a distinctive minty, earthy aroma with cool fuel notes. The high is intensely relaxing and euphoric — a creeping, long-lasting stone.

name: London Pound Cake 75
description: London Pound Cake 75 is the 75-day phenotype of LPC, selected for maximum terpene expression and density. Its grape, lemon, and berry-cake aroma is extraordinary. The effect is a deeply euphoric and sedating indica-leaning high.

name: Cereal Milk OG
description: Cereal Milk OG merges the creamy, sweet Cereal Milk genetics with classic OG depth. The result is a complex, dessert-forward hybrid with a sweet cream and earthy OG aroma — grounding and euphoric in equal measure.

name: Motorbreath 15
description: Motorbreath 15 is a legendary cut of the Motorbreath line (Chemdog × SFV OG Kush) with an intense diesel and earthy aroma. This powerful indica delivers a sedating, heavy body high with deep euphoria — a true gas-station strain.

name: Peanut Butter Gelato
description: Peanut Butter Gelato combines nutty Peanut Butter Breath with creamy Gelato genetics for a rich, dessert experience. Its aroma is unmistakably nutty and sweet, and the effect is a deeply relaxing, euphoric full-body high.

name: Blue Mystic
description: Blue Mystic is a Dutch-bred indica cross of Blueberry and an unknown strain. Its sweet blueberry aroma is soft and pleasant, and the effect is a calm, relaxing body high that doesn't overwhelm — perfect for beginner indica users.

name: Jet Fuel Gelato
description: Jet Fuel Gelato (High Octane OG × Gelato 45) is a fuel-meets-dessert masterpiece. The sharp diesel aroma blends with sweet gelato undertones in an unexpected but harmonious way. The effect is fast, euphoric, and deeply relaxing.

name: GMO Garlic Cookies
description: GMO (Garlic, Mushroom, Onion Cookies) is one of the most pungent strains ever bred. Despite the unusual savory aroma — garlic, coffee, and diesel — the effect is exceptionally potent, deeply euphoric, and sedating. A cult classic.

name: Garlic Cocktail
description: Garlic Cocktail is a powerful hybrid with a complex, savory-meets-sweet aroma — garlic and fuel with fruity undertones. A divisive but rewarding strain, its effect is deeply euphoric and relaxing.

name: Romulan Grapefruit
description: Romulan Grapefruit takes the heavy indica Romulan and brightens it with Grapefruit's citrusy, uplifting qualities. The result is a well-balanced hybrid with a tangy citrus aroma and both body relaxation and mental uplift.

name: Alien Bubba
description: Alien Bubba (Alien Kush × Bubba Kush) is a powerhouse indica cross with a deeply earthy, kushy aroma and an almost narcotic body effect. Dense, sticky buds and serious potency make this a go-to for insomnia and pain.

name: Dosidos 22
description: Dosidos 22 is a sought-after phenotype of Do-Si-Dos, selected for exceptional potency and a minty, lime, and earthy aroma. Its effect is a heavy, long-lasting body stone with euphoric mental overtones.
